quest.title: What is the Meaning of Life?
quest.description: Iaune seems to have changed the spot in which he eats...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Well, that's all the feed I got. Hope they're all full...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I'm feeding these gulls. See, they've almost had their fill.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... When did you and them grow so close?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They didn't steal your fries?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: No. It seems that people specifically come here to feed the gulls, so they've no interest in my fries.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But didn't you say that if you got too far from your workplace, you might miss work?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it's alright. Today's my day off.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: No colleagues here to drag me into work-related chat, and no one or animal to steal my fries... Yes, this is a most suitable place.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: The gulls are a friendly lot. They won't steal my fries, nor will they come charging into me to cause a riot.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Ever since I fed them personally a few times, they seem to recognize me. They don't seem to resist even when I touch their feathers.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I'd go so far as to call them perfect gentlemen compared to the ilk at the Palais Mermonia.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: If they could use their talons to write using typewriters, why, they'd nearly put us out of work.

choices.text: Violetgold Angler Gulls won't help with human business.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: But at least they don't make things worse, either. And everyone knows that some things are simply too hard for them.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: But let's leave that aside first. Would you like to try making friends with these gentle-gulls?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, they're already gentle-birdies in your eyes, huh...

choices.text: Would it be rude of me to just go up to them?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: No, they are a tolerant sort. As long as you don't ruffle their feathers, you'll be fine.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Come, let me give you this fish I've specially processed. Just take it and put it in that bowl over there.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Just relax. Violetgold Angler Gulls are a tolerant lot. They like whoever feeds them, and they ask no questions about where you got your fish or how it was made.

choices.text: Is there anything I need to look out for when befriending them?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Not much, not really. Just don't attempt to ruffle their feathers directly.

choices.text: Violetgold Angler Gulls don't speak our language.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I wouldn't be so sure. Perhaps they simply pretend so that they may live more comfortable lives.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: What did I say, eh? Real gentlemen — far better mannered than those ruffians near the Palais Mermonia.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They were very well-mannered.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I know, right? Makes me feel relaxed just sitting here.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I mean, just imagine being a gull yourself. With people coming over to feed you, all you need to do is sunbathe and think about the meaning of life...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* Why am I a Gestionnaire and not a Violetgold Angler Gull?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: How... How could you do that? They're not the ruffians in front of the Palais Mermonia, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, it was an accident...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* I didn't even have time to stop you. Why did you do that... Did one of them attack you?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Regardless, they're gone now. Oh well. I'll have to come back in a few days and offer them some food as an apology...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I specially processed this fish. Take it and put it in that bowl over there.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Just relax. Violetgold Angler Gulls are a tolerant lot. They like whoever feeds them, and they ask no questions about where you got your fish or how it was made.
